purpose: Parseable matrix for overlay-specific screenshot, replay, and cross-surface parity scenarios. This is the planning contract for what each overlay must prove across browser review, localhost/OBS, Windows native, compact replay fixtures, and optional full-capture replay.

productDescriptor.relationship: The app does not consume this JSON. App-owned overlay behavior descriptors define stable product policy; this contract references and tests against those descriptors so screenshot and replay coverage stays aligned.

statusValues.covered: The scenario has deterministic validation in the named tier and surfaces.
statusValues.partial: Some validation exists, but it is missing a surface, a semantic assertion, replay evidence, or a known edge case.
statusValues.missing: The scenario is known needed and has no durable validation yet.
statusValues.not_applicable: The scenario does not apply to this overlay or surface.

surfaces.browserReview: Generated browser-review route and screenshot manifest.
surfaces.localhostObs: Production localhost/OBS route and screenshot manifest.
surfaces.windowsNative: Windows native screenshot artifact and manifest where the overlay exists natively.
surfaces.settingsUi: Settings app page/component screenshot and uiEvidence manifest.
surfaces.compactReplay: Small committed capture-derived frame/model summary replayed through production logic.
surfaces.fullCaptureReplay: Optional/nightly explicit raw capture replay, not required in fast PR CI.

tiers.name: Tier 1 - CI Contract Fixtures
tiers.artifactPolicy: commit small deterministic fixtures and generated manifests; do not commit full raw capture folders
requiredAssertions: row, column, section, marker, flag, or message counts
required visible text and forbidden stale/misleading text
width, height, crop, body, and content bounds
settings hash parity where a surface can drift

tiers.name: Tier 2 - Capture-Derived Replay Fixtures
tiers.cadence: PR for compact fixtures after a bug is understood; optional local for broader windows
tiers.artifactPolicy: commit tiny capture-derived frame/model summaries; keep full capture-* directories out of required CI
requiredAssertions: raw telemetry fields explain the selected frame/window
production model output matches the intended product behavior
rendered screenshot manifest matches the model
known issue is either reproduced or explicitly classified as not present in the selected window

tiers.name: Tier 3 - Release / Native Parity Gate
tiers.cadence: release, pre-release, or heavier CI gate
tiers.artifactPolicy: generate Windows native screenshots/manifests and compare them with browser review and localhost artifacts
requiredAssertions: browser review, localhost/OBS, and Windows native agree on semantic state for the same data/settings
geometry and image size match exactly or within documented overlay-specific tolerance
native unsupported surfaces are explicitly declared
full raw-capture replay remains optional/nightly unless promoted to a compact fixture

globalRequirements.description: Parity scenarios must identify the exact fixture, capture-derived frame/model summary, preview mode, enabled content, chrome state, scale, opacity, and route alias used by each surface.

Screenshots should validate pixels after model/evidence contracts prove that the model is meaningful. Row identity, source labels, unavailable policy, and forbidden stale content are first-class assertions.

Every overlay must explicitly declare whether enabled header/footer chrome can render without body data. Stable chrome-only waiting states and true no-render states must both be validated where applicable.
At 60% scale, product content should scale visually. It must not silently hide columns, rows, markers, graph content, or chrome unless a separate content setting disables them.
Telemetry-rich captures must classify each expected OBS overlay as not-requested, page-loaded-no-model, model-polled-hidden, model-rendered, or browser-source-error.
